sources.primary_title: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN Expand Saudi Arabia’s AI Infrastructure as AMD Instinct Systems Go Live
sources.verified_angle_summary: On August 31, 2026, AMD, Cisco, and HUMAIN announced a major milestone at LEAP 2026: their joint venture's AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia is now live. Powered by AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, AMD EPYC CPUs, and Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking, this production deployment provides scalable, sovereign AI compute for HUMAIN customers in the Kingdom and beyond. The partnership also detailed plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure starting in 2027 using AMD Instinct MI400 Series GPUs, remaining on track to reach a 1 GW capacity by 2030. This concrete infrastructure deployment provides a distinct, highly specific news angle compared to generic previews of executives headlining the event.
sources.verified_key_facts: AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure is now live in Saudi Arabia; The deployment utilizes Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking and Cisco 800G optics; The joint venture plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure beginning in 2027; The 2027 expansion will feature AMD Instinct MI400 Series GPUs and AMD ROCm open software; The partnership remains on track to deploy up to 1 GW of AI infrastructure by 2030; The infrastructure provides sovereign AI compute capabilities for model training and inferencing.
